summary: View-model-first navigation for ReactiveUI applications, including page, modal, Avalonia, MAUI, and popup integrations.
recommendedPatterns: Put IViewStackService behind application navigation abstractions.
Register the navigation view and view/view-model mappings at startup.
Observe navigation stacks and lifecycle through the supplied contracts.
avoidPatterns: Do not mutate platform navigation stacks behind Sextant.
Do not forget to subscribe to cold navigation operations.
Do not update UI-bound navigation state off the UI sequencer.
setupSteps: Add Sextant plus the matching platform package.
Register views, view models, and the navigation host at the composition root.
Add Sextant.Plugins.Popup only when Mopups popup navigation is required.
commonPitfalls: Missing view/view-model registrations fail at navigation time.
Navigation observables do nothing until subscribed.
Modal, page, and popup stacks have different semantics.

features: Mopups popup integration and test doubles
options: MAUI, Avalonia, or popup platform adapter
sourceGeneratorGuidance: Use ReactiveUI.SourceGenerators for navigable view-model properties and commands; Sextant navigation itself remains runtime orchestration.
Use generated IViewFor registrations where supported before adding manual mappings.
compatibilityNotes: Navigation operations are observable and require subscription.
Use the reactive package family chosen by the host consistently and marshal UI work through its main-thread sequencer.
migrationGuidance: Replace direct platform navigation calls behind IViewStackService incrementally.
Preserve page/modal contracts while moving view-model boilerplate to ReactiveUI.SourceGenerators.
